title: MOSAiC snow density profile PS122-1_10-11
citation: Macfarlane, Amy R et al. (2022): Snowpit snow density cutter profiles measured during the MOSAiC expedition. PANGAEA.
processing: Select all four records with Event PS122-1_10-11.
Retain published density values. Original balance readings are not included in this file.
Top and Bottom are centimetres above the snow–ice interface.
Verify matching site and timestamp, positive finite density, contiguous intervals ending at zero, and no comments.
SWE in mm = sum(density in kg/m3 * interval thickness in cm / 100). Reference water density 1000 kg/m3.
Mean density = SWE in mm / total profile height in metres.
No interpolation, gap filling, density correction or exclusion within the selected profile.
Selection demonstrates a complete vertical profile and is not a representative sample of Arctic snow.
limitations: Published layer densities, not raw masses or calibration certificates.
One sample per interval, no repeatability estimate or profile-specific uncertainty budget.
Water equivalent uses a freshwater reference and is not a salinity-corrected meltwater volume.
Number of decimal places in the calculation is not measurement uncertainty.
